description: Read one exact deferred draft: bounded prompt/ref preview with explicit omissions, predecessor result path, successor handles and `controls`, the values frozen at creation by origin (inherited from the predecessor, resolved at creation, captured Settings preferences) with their capture time. Permissions, trust, accounts and quota are not frozen. This read never dispatches. A terminal predecessor may still have a waiting or held draft; inspect its state.
name: claudexor_next_message_read

outputSchema.description: Bounded editable-content snapshot. Read the exact predecessorResult path (or claudexor_run_result for its job/run handle) for predecessor output; output is never duplicated here. Terminal predecessor observation does not imply draft resolution.

items.description: Reference to an immutable daemon-owned uploaded resource.

resourceId.description: Immutable daemon resource id returned by upload finalize.

anyOf.description: Frozen effective controls. Dispatch reads tool permissions, account and harness enablement, trust, quota, capabilities, paid-fallback policy and other settings afresh; a refusal holds the draft.

capturedAt.description: Draft creation; edits never recapture controls.

inherited.description: Continuation-inherited groups from the predecessor's accepted request (mode, scope, execution, harness and model groups, promptCacheTtl); omitted per-harness models were completed from Settings at creation.

resolved.description: Create-time controls as captured: explicit draft controls, otherwise ordinary new-run defaults at creation, never the predecessor's value. An omitted access is the project's default access at creation, not the predecessor's.

authPreference.description: Preferred auth route: subscription (native/OAuth session), api_key (a stored API key), or auto (engine picks subscription-first with policy fallback). A preference, not a secret.

items.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

auth_preference.description: Preferred auth route: subscription (native/OAuth session), api_key (a stored API key), or auto (engine picks subscription-first with policy fallback). A preference, not a secret.

default_model.description: Per-harness default model; null = the harness's own default.

anyOf.description: Cross-harness reasoning-effort level as a lowercase slug (open vocabulary, mirroring the vendor contract); adapters advertise the levels they accept per model, ordered weakest to strongest by the vendor itself, and a shared normalizer passes advertised levels through, clamps inside the vendor order, places a word the vendor order lacks by the shared preference order (none < minimal < low < medium < high < xhigh < max < ultra) onto an advertised level, and refuses words neither order places.

effort.description: Default reasoning effort for the harness; null = harness default.

fallback_model.description: Model to fall back to on typed fallback signals; null = none.

max_rounds.description: Default max convergence rounds; null = engine default.

max_turns.description: Default max agent turns; null = no limit.

web.description: Default web policy for this harness.

anyOf.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

primaryHarness.description: User-supplied string that must contain visible content, not just whitespace.

settings.description: Settings execution preferences captured at creation (per-harness defaults, eligible and primary harness, auth preference), used at dispatch instead of current values.

draft.description: Compact addressed draft state, with exact predecessor result and successor handles. A terminal predecessor does not imply the draft has resolved.

anyOf.description: Stable hold. Editing, observation and readiness restoration never rearm it; inspect the predecessor result and clear before an ordinary continuation.

problem.description: Typed, sanitized problem for a thread turn that could not start.

code.description: Machine-readable refusal code carried from the throwing gate; null when the failure had no typed code.

context.description: Bounded typed recovery context; never arbitrary provider or environment output.

required_actions.description: Bounded user actions that may make an exact retry succeed.

retryable.description: True when retry can replay this turn (a job was recorded before the failure); false when no job exists to replay.

hold.description: Stable hold. Editing, observation and readiness restoration never rearm it; inspect the predecessor result and clear before an ordinary continuation.

predecessorResult.description: Existing addressed run-detail/result path; no duplicate result store.
